name: taskpulse-realtime-platform
description: Full-Stack Real-Time Collaboration and Task Management Platform using MERN Stack, TypeScript, and Socket.IO

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:client && npm run build:server

author: Ayush Mishra
